stopping_rules.rule: Before provider action commit tooling, register/freeze v9, commit freeze, publish exact ref, and substitute frozen hash for token.
Authorize one RunPod allocation and one combined command only; no pilot, resume, replacement row, or second allocation.
After exact build/test gates attempt 4 arms x 6 cases x (3 warmups + 20 measured) = 552 invocations at 100 operations, then stop.
Attempt each cell once, fsync every attempted row including instrument failures, retain failures, never extend/select/replace/reorder.
Any complete fingerprint disagreement in any warmup/measured four-arm cell or across rounds within a case is terminal wrong_answer.

Cumulative L2 failure retains exact/count metrics but makes row clocks invalid. A/A calibration failure leaves raw L2-valid row clocks unchanged but invalidates the aggregate timing claim. Neither authorizes retry.

invalidation_rules: No v9 benchmark invocation, fingerprint, allocation/timing observation, provider action, or row may predate v9 registration and freeze. Pre-registration local source/build/correctness tooling smoke checks are mechanical validation only and never v9 evidence.

Any mismatch in protocol/freeze/registration, ref/source archive, tooling, production source, blobs, Go archive, build/test/binaries, command/environment/schedule, receipt/archive/extraction, cleanup, export, or raw artifact is mechanical failure/inconclusive.
Synthetic arms overlay coord_test.go identically and differ only at coord.go; baseline and both A/A binaries must have identical SHA-256.
Another placement, price, memory, cgroup limit, GPU, CPU count/flavor, image, or transport invalidates allocation.
Missing/duplicate/malformed, wrong b.N, nonzero/timeout, parse failure, absent fingerprint/metric, or failed go test is mechanically inconclusive; no partial claim/retry.
Any complete four-arm or case-invariance fingerprint disagreement, including warmup, is wrong_answer before ratios.

Failed lock, preflight, SMT reservation, eviction, whole-tree affinity/parallelism, cleanup, schedstat, steal, foreign sampling, PSI full delta, ivcsw, restoration, throttle/events, or placement withholds L2 and invalidates clocks while counts/correctness survive.

A/A interval failure to contain one or remain within [20/21,21/20] invalidates the aggregate timing claim without relabeling L2-valid raw clocks; fixed L/R labels are used with no reciprocal-orientation claim.
V7 and abandoned zero-data v8 are not v9 evidence.

decision_rule.text: Require mechanical completeness then all 138 four-arm correctness cells and case invariance. Allocation passes iff both candidate/baseline medians <=1/20 in all cases. Timing requires cumulative L2 and valid fixed-label A/A: exact [1/960,959/960] interval contains 1 and lies within [20/21,21/20], N=max(upper,1/lower); then each A/B median >=21/20 and 1/960 lower >max(1,N). Exact rational bootstrap has no RNG. Incomplete is inconclusive; mismatch wrong_answer; failed L2 or A/A makes the aggregate timing claim invalid_measurement while allocation survives (only L2 failure invalidates raw row clocks); otherwise combined/allocation_only/timing_only/unsupported.
decision_rule.threshold: all 552 fingerprints/case invariants exact; allocation medians <=1/20; cumulative L2; A/A contains 1 within [20/21,21/20]; A/B medians >=21/20 and lower >max(1,N)
decision_rule.statistic: Per case/replicate candidate/baseline allocation, baseline/candidate A/B clocks, fixed A/A-left/A/A-right clocks; exact even-N median averages sorted positions 10 and 11.
decision_rule.interval: For 24 clock cells enumerate exact empirical paired-bootstrap median distribution via joint order-statistic masses; quantiles 1/960 and 959/960 use inf{x:CDF(x)>=q}; no RNG/interpolation/Monte Carlo/asymptotics/label reversal.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: paired median allocation, A/B speedup, fixed-label A/A ratio per case
